objective: Test whether causal R-JF-only persistence plus a hard speculative-prefix budget can identify durable R-to-E opportunities without any E-K continuation or active switching.

calibration_replay.role: policy selection using previously existing G4-S5B0 audit labels

cross_dimension_regression.role: non-sealed regression only; N=512 was already inspected in prior mathematical research

prefix_prospective_bound.calibration_rule: 1.25 * max over calibration of prefix_wall[j+1] / rodas_wall[j], with trajectory boundaries excluded
prefix_prospective_bound.holdout_rule: freeze the calibration ratio; after committing R row j, allow a next-state prefix only if cumulative_speculative + bound_ratio * rodas_wall[j] <= delta * cumulative_committed_r_jf_wall
prefix_prospective_bound.realized_audit_cost: prefix_wall[j+1] from the historical optimized atlas, read only after the probe decision

calibration_selection: hard reject any candidate with prefix bound violation
hard reject any candidate with proposed pathwise prefix budget violation
use R-to-E entry-count recall only as a reported diagnostic
interpretation_limits: This node is an event/probe-economics preflight, not an E-K safety certificate.
Full E-K shadows are audit oracle work and are retained in the complete measurement ledger but excluded from proposed runtime cost because the candidate policy never performs them.
No threshold from this node authorizes active switching.
N=512 is not a sealed holdout in this node because it was already used in the preceding mathematical research loop.
A later genuinely unseen validation dimension/family is required before promotion beyond research preflight.
stop_conditions: any parent/source hash drift before implementation
any policy feature depends on E-K or transition oracle data
any active E-K continuation or committed state mutation

solver_execution_in_this_node.new_solver_path: R-JF-only committed trajectories; no E-K evaluation is required for the new run
solver_execution_in_this_node.audit_join: join R-JF rows by trajectory_id and accepted step index to the already-durable optimized G4-S5B0 atlas after exact numerical parity checks
solver_execution_in_this_node.timing_authority: historical optimized G4-S5B0 median R/E/prefix walls, never debug wall times
solver_execution_in_this_node.reason: avoid duplicating expensive E shadow work when the required audit labels already exist; preserve same-physics evidence and complete provenance

causal_indexing.feature_observation: accepted R-JF row j becomes observable only after completing that step
causal_indexing.probe_launch: a trigger fired from row j may launch an E-K prefix only at the next committed state, corresponding to audit row j+1
causal_indexing.forbidden: same-row E-K prefix/admissibility/winner labels may not score a decision based on row-j R-JF telemetry
causal_indexing.terminal_row: no probe is launched if there is no row j+1 in the trajectory

amendment_provenance.reason: prevent one-step look-ahead leakage in event-to-prefix alignment
